comments.author: Alexander Terp
comments.body:
Measured, not inferred: docs/observations/herdr-0.8.0.md section 11, evidence in corpus/herdr-0.8.0/lifecycle/.

A client subscribed to all 24 unparameterized subscription types sees nothing when a pane's agent goes working -> idle -> blocked. A second client on the same daemon, subscribed to pane.agent_status_changed with a pane_id, sees every one of them.

So the sidebar costs one held-open connection per pane, opened as panes appear and dropped as they go. The ask: make pane.agent_status_changed work unparameterized, the way pane.updated already does.

comments.author: Alexander Terp
comments.body: Measured before the sidebar was built (observations/herdr-0.8.0.md section 11). Sixteen watchers cost one thread and ~48 KB per pane, idle at zero CPU - so this drops from something to press for to something to mention. Muster ships the sidebar without it.

creator: Alexander Terp
title: 🔌 Upstream: agent state needs a subscription per pane
